declarations.type:
∀ {SnapshotId : Type}
  (candidate :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.AuthorityBoundCandidate SnapshotId)
  (candidates :
    List
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.AuthorityBoundCandidate SnapshotId)),
  candidate ∈ candidates →
    candidate.declaredFaultBound ≤
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.maximumCandidateBound candidates
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.candidate_bound_is_at_most_maximum

declarations.type:
∀ {SnapshotId : Type}
  (actualFaultWeight : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.VotingWeight)
  (witness :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.AuthorityBoundCandidate SnapshotId)
  (candidates :
    List
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.AuthorityBoundCandidate SnapshotId)),
  witness ∈ candidates →
    actualFaultWeight ≤ witness.declaredFaultBound →
      actualFaultWeight ≤
        ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.maximumCandidateBound candidates
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.conservative_witness_makes_maximum_safe

declarations.type:
∀ {SnapshotId : Type}
  (candidate :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.AuthorityBoundCandidate SnapshotId)
  (candidates :
    List
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.AuthorityBoundCandidate SnapshotId)),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.maximumCandidateBound candidates ≤
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.maximumCandidateBound
      (candidate :: candidates)
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.adding_candidate_does_not_decrease_maximum

declarations.type:
∃ actualFaultWeight lowReport conservativeReport,
  lowReport < actualFaultWeight ∧
    actualFaultWeight ≤ conservativeReport ∧ Nat.min lowReport conservativeReport < actualFaultWeight
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.minimum_aggregation_can_understate_actual_fault_weight

declarations.type:
∃ totalWeight quorumWeight partialBound expandedBound,
  partialBound ≤ expandedBound ∧
    totalWeight + partialBound < quorumWeight + quorumWeight ∧
      ¬totalWeight + expandedBound < quorumWeight + quorumWeight
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.partial_authority_search_can_pass_before_final_bound_fails

declarations.type:
∀ (actualFaultWeight aggregateBound : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.VotingWeight)
  (authenticReports : Prop),
  authenticReports → aggregateBound < actualFaultWeight → authenticReports ∧ ¬actualFaultWeight ≤ aggregateBound
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinMultiAuthorityFaultAggregation.authentic_reports_without_conservative_witness_are_insufficient
